text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Incredible, incredible, incredible!! Here 
comes Cheval Grand! Cheval Grand makes her 
move right here!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Pushing through a field of powerful 
rivals— Cheval Grand takes the victory!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAH!!)

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
W-W-Whoaaa!!!! Cheval is amazing! Cheval 
actually won, Sis!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
She's really... incredible... When on 
earth did that girl get this good...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ………………Eh... Eeeeeh?!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I won...? Did I really...? Y-Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I did it…… but――

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(I'm happy... right? I should be 
celebrating, but... somehow...—)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (...What is this feeling...?)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (I still... can't stop the goosebumps...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Murmur... murmur...)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Daaammit, that was so close, Duramente!! I 
was sure you had it!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"That final burst of speed at the end was 
incredible... It gave me chills just 
watching it..."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (I see... It's Duramente-san...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(The true nature of that terrifying 
presence that clung to me the whole time I 
was running—)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: “...... What's this?”

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"N-No, I'm so, so sorry. I just... um... 
sort of—"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I-I-It was just so amazing... the way you 
ran...! It was... so powerful...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(I thought I was going to be swallowed 
whole... By some massive, unknown 
beast...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(That's how... ferocious her presence 
was...)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...However, if I don't win, none of it 
means anything.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
For someone like me who seeks to be 'the 
strongest,' you are saying that anything 
less than victory is 'worthless.'

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...I run to prove that my bloodline brings 
about the 'strongest'—that is why I race.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
In other words, victory is a 
"prerequisite." Failing to fulfill that 
"prerequisite," I have no right to speak 
of today's race.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: That's right... Victory is my sole duty—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Next time, I will prove who is the 
"strongest."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: They're... gone...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(How intense... Chasing "the strongest"—so 
straightforwardly...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(That's Duramente-san's resolve. A fierce 
determination to make her dream come true, 
no matter what...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Am I really going to compete against 
someone like her...? To make my dream come 
true, I'll have to surpass her again and 
again...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Besides......—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...! It's so frustrating...! But I'm not 
done yet either...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I had all the data prepared... It's just 
that I didn't reach the level expected of 
me...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"...Why, isn't this getting interesting? 
Next time, I will be the one--!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Kita-san. Crown-san, too...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Why can you look forward so quickly? If I 
were in your shoes... surely――)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I go to greet Cheval Grand in the 
underground tunnel after her monumental 
upset in the Satsuki Sho."
choice_data_list:
Good work today! You were amazing out 
there!
Good work today! You were awesome!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah... um, ...yes!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. Thank you... so much.
choice_data_list:
Didn't this give you a real boost in 
confidence?
Hasn't this given you more confidence?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After all, even surrounded by formidable 
rivals like Duramente and others, she had 
still managed to claim victory.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: C-Confidence... you say? ...Um—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Confidence... I'm not really sure. 
Today... I found myself getting 
overwhelmed a lot, so—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Because if I run one more time... I don't 
know if I can win again...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah, no!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
E-Everyone was... truly amazing. That's 
why I need to work even harder, too...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even though she was more incredible than 
anyone else today, she herself didn't seem 
to realize it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I wished for the day when I'd see her puff 
out her chest and proudly declare, "I was 
amazing!"
